empty results skipped.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    run = []\\n    for ch in text:\\n        if ch.isalpha() or ch == \\\"'\\\":\\n            run.append(ch)\\n        else:\\n            if run:\\n                word = \\\"\\\".join(run).lower().strip(\\\"'\\\")\\n                if word:\\n                    yield word\\n                run = []\\n    if run:\\n        word = \\\"\\\".join(run).lower().strip(\\\"'\\\")\\n        if word:\\n            yield word\\n\\n\\ndef main(argv=None):\\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\\n        prog=\\\"wordfreq.py\\\",\\n        description=\\\"Count word frequencies in a UTF-8 text file.\\\",\\n    )\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"file\\\", help=\\\"input file (read as UTF-8)\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"-n\\\", type=positive_int, default=10, metavar=\\\"N\\\",\\n                        help=\\\"number of top words to print (default: 10)\\\")\\n    parser.add_argument(\\\"--min-len\\\", type=int, default=1, metavar=\\\"K\\\",\\n                        help=\\\"ignore words shorter than K characters (default: 1)\\\")\\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\\n\\n    try:\\n        with open(args.file, encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\") as fh:\\n            text = fh.read()\\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):\\n        print(f\\\"error: cannot read {args.file}\\\", file=sys.stderr)\\n        return 1\\n\\n    counts = Counter()\\n    for word in extract_words(text):\\n        if len(word) >= args.min_len:\\n            counts[word] += 1\\n\\n    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))\\n    out = \\\"\\\\n\\\".join(f\\\"{word} {count}\\\" for word, count in ranked[:args.n])\\n    try:\\n        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\")\\n    except (AttributeError, ValueError):\\n        pass\\n    if out:\\n        sys.stdout.write(out + \\\"\\\\n\\\")\\n    return 0\\n\\n\\nif __name__ == \\\"__main__\\\":\\n    sys.exit(main())\\n\"}"]]}
